requirement: IRATEPILOT OTA INTEGRATION / Hotel direct booking engine
scope: Local tests for the iRatePilot marketplace hotel search, listing presentation, booking request, quote calculation, deduplication and approval bookability.
command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/marketplace-search.test.ts tests/marketplace-presentation.test.ts tests/booking.test.ts tests/booking-quote.test.ts tests/booking-deduplication.test.ts tests/booking-write-security.test.ts tests/booking-approval-bookability.test.ts tests/production-test-checkout-gates.test.ts
verified: Search criteria validate future dates and guest counts; availability requires every night and adequate capacity.
Listing presentation distinguishes database-backed availability from demos and labels demo room examples non-bookable.
Server-side booking uses approved room/property state and verified nightly pricing instead of trusting client totals.
Duplicate open stays return the existing request rather than creating another.
Booking creation is server-side, authenticated and rejected when the property or room becomes inactive before approval.
Production checkout remains gated unless explicitly configured.
limitations: This is local unit and PGlite acceptance, not a live browser or hosted production booking test.
The booking request requires customer authentication and partner approval; it is not instant-confirmation inventory.
Production payment checkout was not enabled or verified.
No OTA-to-PMS end-to-end reservation was made during this check.
